brainlife.desc: Task events table for an fMRI run (BIDS events.tsv, optional JSON and CSV), for events not uploaded with the BOLD.
brainlife.name: neuro/func/events

original.desc: Datatype containing the events.tsv file for a fmri task-based experiment (in case user did not upload with func datatype)

brainlife.readme:
**Use for:** Concatenating runs and their events into one timeline. Task GLM design when paired with a BOLD run.

**Not for:** Pairing with a BOLD run from a different session or run.

**BIDS:** func/events (partial)

**Sharing:** Tier 2 (pseudonymised participant-level) by default.

**Apps:** Input to 1 App, output of 1 App.

Full record: https://github.com/brainlife/abcd-spec/blob/master/datatypes/neuro.func.events.json

files.desc: Events as CSV (non-BIDS), e.g. concatenated across runs.

identifying_risks: Free-text columns or response data may reveal personal information
governance.rationale: Tool 1 step 6: participant-level behavioural records linkable through a code.
tier_conditions: Tier 4 if response columns build a cognitive or behavioural profile

sources: catalog/apps/<app_id>.json (manifests of the Apps in usage)
